description:
The year is 2052 — an era of unprecedented peace and prosperity prevails across the globe. The reason for this: mankind has been freed from sickness and pain. Nobel Prize winning neuroscientist Dr. Skinner has developed a miracle cure-all drug with no apparent drawbacks called Hapuna. Hapuna soon becomes ubiquitous… and essential. However, soon after Hapuna is officially introduced, Dr. Skinner vanishes.

Three years later, the world has moved on. But Dr. Skinner has returned — this time, as a harbinger of doom. Skinner announces that Hapuna has a short half-life. Everyone who has taken it will die approximately three years later. Death is coming for this sinful world — and coming soon.

As a response to this threat, a special task force of 5 agents is gathered from across the world to save humanity from Skinner’s plan. This group is called “Lazarus.” Can they find Skinner and develop a vaccine before time runs out?

(Source: Adult Swim)

node.description: Parkour specialist originally from Brazil. He has outstanding physical abilities and is a quick thinker, who can fly through the city like a bird. He is famous for his numerous jailbreaks.

Originally from Nigeria. He's an intelligent man who creates strategies as the brains of the team, and hides his warm heart behind a calm and collected demeanor. As a student, he studied physics and had a great respect for [Dr. Skinner.](https://anilist.co/character/347658/Skinner) He has a high-strung and prideful personality.

Originally from Russia. She has a lively and frank personality, allowing her to get along with anyone. She acts as a gun specialist, who can use any type of gun. She is also a heavy drinker and optimist.

~!Christine is not her real name, she changed her face and identity after defecting from Russian intelligence.!~

Originally from Canada. His special skill is piloting drones. He seems like a normal dumb middle school student, but has a complicated family situation which is kept secret. He is skilled at reading the room but never says his real intentions. His hobby is ego surfing.

alternative: Mad Screamer (マッド・スクリーマー)

node.description: Originally from Hong Kong. Although she seems unsociable and is bad at listening to what others say, she is actually a famous hacker under the name "Mad Screamer."

Leader of Lazarus. She has a lot of influence on both nations and large corporations, and does her job without being carried away by emotions. She is an angry and terrifying woman.

~!She used to work with Skinner as a fellow researcher at the Hague.!~
Director of the National Security Agency (NSA). He is always unfazed, calm, and rational, to the point his colleagues questioned if he is secretly an AI.

Skinner is a three-time Nobel Prize winning scientist. He suddenly disappeared three years ago. He is the inventor of the cure-all drug Hapna, and was seen as a saint for donating his patent and prize money to solving world issues.

Former Associate Professor in the Departyment of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at MIT, focusing on the development of AI systems capable of quantum-level processing. He developed the AI Naga and formed a commune that worships Naga as a God.
Russian Intelligence special agent working alongside Inga.
